confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Alcohol prices and wine availability are less certain because Kerala has high liquor taxes and limited wine supply. Accommodation anchors use off-season monsoon rates since July is low season in Munnar, but hostel and guesthouse prices vary widely. The FX observation was taken from an RBA homepage summary returned by search, and I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Kerala and southern Indian hill-station pricing (Kodaikanal, Ooty, Coorg/Madikeri), adjusted for Munnar's July monsoon low season for accommodation.
